pages.text: When a bar reaches 100 it $(l)breaks$(). The victim is knocked back and becomes $(4)Overpowered$() for a few seconds: much slower, and dealing 15% less damage.$(br2)Overpowered is your opening to press the attack.

$(bold)Bosses$() don't slow down. A broken boss is $(4)Staggered$() for a moment (it can't move or deal damage) and then $(4)Exposed$(): weakened like Overpowered, but still moving at full speed.$(br2)Bosses and elites also shrug off part of the pressure you deal.
